# Pirate Arcade

Pirate Arcade is a public game and build-log project by Erich Donahue. It combines a five-game collection (4 browser-playable + 1 desktop-only) with an Astro static website, GitHub releases, and Cloudflare Pages hosting.

## Project summary

The project asks how much of a complete, inspectable, public software project one person can ship using local hardware, free-to-use AI coding tools, open source software, GitHub, and Cloudflare's free tier. It is not a commercial game studio or subscription product.

## Games

Total: 5 games. 4 browser-playable (3 Pygbag/WebAssembly ports, 1 web-native Phaser racer). 1 desktop-only.

- Cannonball Clash: a naval Pong riff with power-ups, procedural audio, AI opponent support, and browser play at https://pirate-arcade.com/play/cannonball-clash/. Pygbag/WebAssembly port.
- Treasure Cove: a treasure-hunt brick breaker with score combos, paddle power-up, procedural audio, and browser play at https://pirate-arcade.com/play/treasure-cove/. Pygbag/WebAssembly port.
- Kraken's Wake: an Asteroids-style sea-monster survival game, playable in browser at https://pirate-arcade.com/play/krakens-wake/. Pygbag/WebAssembly port.
- Race to Treasure Island: a top-down pirate ship racer with AI rivals, wind boost, and deterministic seeded obstacle course, playable in browser at https://pirate-arcade.com/play/race-to-treasure-island/. Web-native Phaser — loads instantly, no runtime download.
- Port Royale Tycoon: a pirate property-trading board game, desktop-only release.

## Technology

- Desktop games: Python, Pygame, NumPy, procedural audio.
- Browser ports: Pygbag, WebAssembly, Web Audio API bridge.
- Web-native games: Phaser, Vite.
- Website: Astro 7, TypeScript, vanilla CSS, Cloudflare Pages.
- Distribution: GitHub repositories, CI, and releases.
- Development constraint: local X600 workstation, free-to-use AI models, no paid AI subscriptions, no cloud compute.
